## Orientation

Territory: you share this wave with evidence-surfaces. Write only `/home/andrewyin/se-workflow--evidence-view/dashboard/requirement_detail.py` and `/home/andrewyin/se-workflow--evidence-view/tests/test_dashboard_requirement.py`. Do not edit `dashboard/app.py`, `dashboard/tasks.py`, `dashboard/task_detail.py`, `dashboard/model.py`, or `tests/test_dashboard_app.py`. evidence-surfaces is editing `app.py`, `tasks.py`, and `tests/test_dashboard_app.py` at the same time. Do not import from those files in a way that requires them to change.

The class signature is frozen: `RequirementDetailScreen(target, effort, phase, requirement)`. Wave 3 will construct it. Model it on `dashboard/task_detail.py` (`TaskDetailScreen`). Load with `model.load_requirement_detail` in a worker. Redraw when the app refreshes on a store change, the same way the task screen does. Bind esc back, c copy, r refresh.

`TaskDetailScreen(target, task_id)` is the existing constructor. Enter on a traced task pushes that. `RequirementDetail.tasks` is a tuple of `TaskRow` (`id`, `subject`, `title`, `status`).

Sections: header chips (id, status, next, phase), requirement text, decisions (`DecisionChoice.subject` and `.choice`), traced tasks as a link list, acceptances with the latest check result and `evidence_kind`, assessment history oldest first (`AssessmentView`: status, level, next, confidence). An unassessed requirement shows `unassessed` with the latest check result dimmed. Use the app palette. No line wider than the pane at 60 columns.

Do not edit `.artifacts`. Do not call `adaptive-artifacts` against the project store. Tests seed temp stores the way `tests/test_dashboard_app.py` does. Run from the worktree. Write the pilot tests first and see them fail. The shell function `adaptive-artifacts` points at `~/.artifacts/se-workflow`, not this repo.

## Requirements

R3: Enter on a requirement opens a requirement detail screen showing the requirement text from the specification, the decisions of the tasks traced to it, the traced tasks and acceptances, the latest check-run per acceptance with its evidence kind, and every assessment for it oldest first with status, level, next, and confidence. Enter on a traced task opens its task detail; esc returns one screen at a time.

## Invariants

Status comes only from the latest assessment for that phase and id. Requirement identity is phase plus id. A phase with no specification takes every existing code path unchanged. The dashboard stays read-only.

## Assumptions

Requirement text parses from `R<n>: text` lines under `## Requirements`. Comma-separated `requirements` and `decisions` payloads split on commas with whitespace trimmed. A check-run's phase comes from its acceptance through `criterion_id`. `list --state superseded` returns earlier assessments.

## Decisions

evidence-under-phase: Requirements live under their phase: a tally on the phase header, a list in phase detail, and a requirement detail screen.
unassessed-requirement-status: A requirement with no assessment shows unassessed with the latest check-run result dimmed.
